column28: Shareable is the Jira for Data Scientist: a project management platform for Data Scientists and Analysts to track, document, and share their work.
column29: Shareable is a project management platform for Data Scientists and Analysts to track, document, and share their work.   Data Scientists use a wide variety of processes to keep track of their work, most commonly some combination of CRoss Industry Standard Process for Data Mining (CRISP-DM), Scrum, and Kanban. This is a necessary but not differentiating part of our product, so we will create a simple Kanban board to connect with the rest of the platform.  Within a single Data Science team, work can be output as a Jupyter Notebook, Rmarkdown, Google Doc/Sheet, slide deck, dashboard, and the list goes on. This makes it difficult to document work over time. By creating a structured and searchable template for each of these potential outputs, an entire organization's analytics work can be easily found in one place.  Unlike a Jira ticket in a software engineer’s sprint which is marked done by completing story points and merging a pull request, impactful analytics work isn’t done until it is shared with stakeholders and business outcomes are created. We are creating an easy to share content block for any type of analysis. These content blocks will be integrated with Slack for easy direct communication and populated into a newsfeed for greater visibility.
